conditions.runtime: authenticated player on dedicated SMP with matching JEM Races protocol 3 client

change.summary: Replace three minor cultural roles with five server-authoritative races, innate signatures and persistent three-tier race progression while keeping professions independent.

before.value: small passive traits plus profession and Iron's direct-hit bonuses

after.value: exactly five buffs and two debuffs per race, one innate signature and three persistent behavior-changing tiers independent from professions

before.value: direct role/profession commands and SMP chat-command forwarding

after.value: bounded SMP module packets opening JEM Races or native Pufferfish Skills

before.value: canonical managed-client Paxi datapack absent from ordinary dedicated Server

after.value: same complete profession Paxi datapack present on managed client and dedicated Server

before.value: protected Piglin, End-kin and green-biome acquisition replaced the Forge target with null

after.value: protected acquisition cancels LivingChangeTargetEvent and never supplies a null target to Brain behavior

before.value: tagged fire damage canceled at LivingHurtEvent after client-visible hurt feedback could begin

after.value: tagged fire attacks canceled at highest-priority LivingAttackEvent with the later hurt guard retained and residual fire cleared

before.value: server-spawned generic Heart, Portal, Sculk Soul, Happy Villager and Flame bursts

after.value: bounded protocol-3 accepted-transition events drive client-only Lodestone particles and depth-tested world geometry with LOW/MEDIUM/HIGH/ULTRA decorative budgets

rationale.purpose: Give each race a strong gameplay identity and reliable innate progression while preserving native professions, economy, boss boundaries and authenticated account ownership.
rationale.decision_source: Direct user-supplied JEM Races complete rework specification and runtime report that the profession window was empty; implementation seams and deterministic legacy mapping chosen by Codex from current source and installed artifacts.

introduced.summary: Implemented five races, innate signatures, persistent three-tier mastery, three-column UI, bounded SMP entrypoints and the missing dedicated-server profession datapack.

history.summary: Removed direct role/profession commands, old profession race bonus, old Iron direct-hit bonus and the obsolete dwarf mining tag; SMP module packets and innate race casts are their explicit replacements.
Kept one nonce stable while the screen is open and resolved all runtime race checks through authenticated account identity instead of the player name or offline UUID.

Applied the reported race corrections: Nether Hearteds are fully lava-immune, swim in lava, drink a held lava bucket and telegraph eruptions with fast fire pillars; Ancestors gain an immediate invulnerable guardian below 40%, visible native trade prices and a 25-second multi-target heal; Void Walkers take half a heart and immediately find a full-clearance dry surface; Born in Bloom predicts leaf bridges and uses a 25-second root cooldown; Sculk sees stationary mobs, responds reliably to B, uses a 20-second signature cooldown and replaces explosion confusion with fire vulnerability.

Canceled protected target acquisition instead of injecting null into Piglin Brain behavior, moved Nether fire rejection to the pre-feedback attack phase, and replaced race-owned generic particle bursts with bounded protocol-3 client timelines using Lodestone recipes plus depth-tested Minecraft-native geometry for all five race families.

relations: JEM Identity account -> race SavedData -> server validation -> synchronized client UI
SMP sidebar -> bounded module packet -> native owning screen
race signature use -> separate mastery -> behavior-changing tier
accepted race transition -> bounded protocol-3 visual event -> client-only geometry and Lodestone composition
notes: Legacy active time and free-switch state survive deterministic race migration; changing race resets only race-local mastery/resources.
The installed Iron's 3.15.6 innate-wheel boundary was inspected; no scroll, spellbook or invented spell ID is introduced.
Temporary path blocks persist expiry across unload/restart and drop no resources; short-lived zones and decoys clean themselves while loaded.
Race cards keep concise summaries; clicking a semantic trait icon opens the exact effect in a bounded modal instead of overloading the carousel.
Race VFX has no `/jem vfx` command or synthetic preview route; only real server-accepted transitions emit it.
Critical silhouettes render at every preset without camera shake; presets reduce only decorative particles and trails.
No automated tests or gameplay launch are created or run because project policy requires manual player acceptance.
unresolved: Player-rendered UI, race VFX appearance/FPS and multiplayer gameplay acceptance remain in testing.
Oculus with Photon and Complementary remains unverified until an explicitly authorized `test jem` client launch.
Third-party merchants, barter systems, peaceful mobs or End creatures that do not reuse the verified native classes/events/tables require an explicit adapter or exact configured registry ID.
